description: PD 14,01_01 Predbežné hodnotenie povodňového rizika - pozorované udalosti - povodie Visla is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cdr.eionet.europa.eu. Directive 2007/60/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 October 2007 on the assessment and management of flood risks; Reference in legislation: Article 4, 5, 15 (1). Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE PD 14,01_01 Preliminary flood risk assessment - observed events - Vistula basin" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include INSPIRE prioritný dataset. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
